correctness.rationale: For the stated even/odd parameter range, d is even and all diameter paths have q(k-1) vertices. A clique larger than d+1 must occupy three arms and fails the k-subset geodesic test. A putative q-coloring saturates the k-1 occupancy bound in each of three diameters. For any noncenter color, pairwise arm occupancies equal k-1, forcing an integer equal to (k-1)/2, impossible. The exact small 4-color upper bound uses a depth-residue assignment; direct enumeration on original geodesics corroborates omega=9 and chi=4.
